bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
a=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import os,json,urllib.request;h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]};g=lambda p:json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:18184"+p,headers=h),timeout=8));s=g("/internal/handoff/status");r=g("/internal/resources/status");print(json.dumps({"resident":s["resident"],"active":sum(s["active"].values()),"handoff":bool(s["handoff"]),"recovery":len(s["recovery_pending"]),"queue":r["queued"],"memory_current":r["memory"]["memory.current"],"memory_max":r["memory"]["memory.max"],"cpu_max":r["cpu_max"],"throttled":r["cpu_stat"].get("nr_throttled"),"pressure":r.get("pressure")},sort_keys=True))')
b=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' debug-ai-debug-ai-1)
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="AI_CORE_UDS_POST_HANDOFF_RUNTIME $a DEBUGAI_CONTAINER=$b" --jq '.html_url' >/dev/null
echo AI_CORE_SHARED_READBACK=PASS
